requests.subject: Legal Notice under Section Section for bank statement of account 232342394283 - FIR No. 24334
requests.body:
To,
The Nodal Officer / Compliance Department,
State Bank Of India.

Subject: Requisition of bank statement and transactional details under Section Section.

Sir/Madam,

An investigation is underway regarding cybercrime activities registered under FIR/Case ID: 24334 at Cyber Police Station Cyber Crime Unit, Varanasi.

To trace the trail of fraudulent funds, statement logs are required for the following account:
- Account Holder Name: Rajesh
- Account Number: 232342394283
- Specific duration required: 

Under the authority of Section Section, you are hereby requested to provide:
1. Certified Bank Statement in excel/CSV format for the mentioned duration.
2. Complete customer details, KYC files, and IP logs used for net-banking access.

Please send the requested files as a reply to this official email within 48 hours.

Regards,

Prankit
Police Inspector
Cyber Crime Unit, Varanasi
Email: sadhnil1998@gmail.com | Contact: 9695732481
